$comment: Per-declaration assurance for Broiler.Code. Product projects only: the src/*.Tests suites and the tests/broiler-code-phase0 harnesses, fixtures and payload probes are not listed, so they are not covered. src/Broiler.App/*.cs has no project of its own and is covered through the literal <Compile Include> in the Windows and Linux heads. No source here is third-party-derived, so there are no spdxOverrides.
regenerateCommand: dotnet run --project Broiler.Code/src/Broiler.Code.Review.Cli -c Release -- assurance generate --root Broiler.Code
